item.title: Mainer Frank Del Duca finishes 12th overall in 4-man bobsled finale at Olympics
item.description: Bethel native said it 'hurts' to not win a medal, but added team gave maximum effort.

item.title: Rockland man arrested after driving plow truck toward protesters
item.description: Some of the 75 protesters gathered in Chapman Park were struck by ice and snow from the plow.

item.title: Monday storm to bring blizzard, flood conditions to Maine
item.description: Travel on Monday along the coast should be for "emergencies only," according to forecasters.

item.title: One dead after crash at Waterville gas station
item.description: Waterville police said it appears a pedestrian in Big Apple parking lot was struck when a vehicle veered off Main Street.

item.title: How would Maine’s proposed climate superfund work?
item.description: State lawmakers are considering a bill that would require the world’s largest oil and gas companies to pay for the recovery costs of climate-related disasters.

item.title: Mariners complete 3-game sweep of Bloomington
item.description: Maine wins its 5th straight game to take over 3rd place in the North Division.

item.title: Mavericks, minus Flagg, top Pacers to snap 10-game losing streak
item.description: Khris Middleton scores 25 points and P.J. Washington adds 23 for Dallas, which was without the injured Cooper Flagg for the 3rd straight game.

item.title: Celtics handle Lakers for a season sweep in rivalry’s latest chapter
item.description: Jaylen Brown scores 32 points for Boston, which has won 8 of its last 9 games.
